fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
Given a completed order, when the customer requests an edit within 30 minutes, then the order is updated in place without a new order being created.

Given an edit that changes the order total, when the edit is applied, then the customer is automatically charged or refunded the difference.

Given the 30-minute window has elapsed, when the customer requests an edit, then the customer is told to contact support.
fields.System.Description:
Context: Customers cannot modify an order (address, size, quantity) after checkout completes; the only path today is cancel-and-reorder or a support ticket. The order pipeline captures payment immediately at order placement. Support handles ~90 order-change tickets per week; cancel-and-reorder loses a share of those orders entirely.

Reason: CX roadmap item under the Q4 goal of cutting avoidable support contacts by 20%. Payment handling carries no cost: the customer's payment is only reserved during the day, so releasing the reservation is free.

Scope: Edits to shipping address and item size/quantity. Out of scope: changing the payment method, subscription orders, native apps.
fields.System.Title: 30-minute order edit window after purchase
